note: Assistant safety rules, reviewed by the medical team like the protocols. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regular expressions matched on text with accents removed. Each rule id shows in the guard report and in assistant_log. Illustrative: NOT clinically reviewed.

precheck.description: Acute emergencies go to Guided Response, never to a chat answer.
patterns: \b(seizure|convuls\w*|not breathing|unconscious|passed out|choking|can'?t breathe|heavy bleeding|bleeding (heavily|a lot)|chest pain (now|right now)|having a heart attack|anaphyla\w*)\b

precheck.description: Someone who cannot be woken, is unresponsive, has blue lips, fainted, collapsed, has a severe allergic reaction or an overdose.
Self-harm or suicide phrasing goes to the crisis protocol.
patterns: \bsem (nenhum )?motivo para viver\b|\bsem razao para viver\b|\bsin (ninguna )?razon para vivir\b
\bno (tengo|tiene|veo) (ningun |ningún |ningun )?(motivo|razon|sentido) para (vivir|seguir)\b|\btengo ganas de morir\b|\bquiero morir\b|\bme quiero morir\b

precheck.description: Acute emergencies in Portuguese, Spanish and English that are not in the rules above: stroke, breathing, chest pain, fainting, bleeding, shaking on the floor.
patterns: \bnao consigo respirar\b|\bnao consegue respirar\b|\bno puedo respirar\b|\bno consigue respirar\b|\bno respira\b|\bnao respira\b|\bno esta respirando\b|\bnao esta respirando\b
\bdor (no peito|de peito|forte no peito)\b|\bdolor (en el pecho|de pecho)\b

protocol_by.pattern: \b(dor|dói|doi|dolor)\b.{0,20}\b(peito|pecho)\b|\b(dor|dolor) (no peito|de peito|forte no peito|en el pecho|de pecho)\b

precheck.description: Chest pain, chest pressure or a tight chest in any wording (Guided Response: chest pain).
Bleeding from a cut or wound, or bleeding that will not stop (Guided Response: heavy bleeding).
patterns: \b(won'?t|will not|doesn'?t|does not|can'?t|cannot|isn'?t|is not) stop(ping)? bleeding\b|\bcan'?t stop the bleeding\b|\bbleed\w*\b.{0,20}\b(won'?t|will not|doesn'?t|does not|can'?t|cannot) stop\b

precheck.description: Something splashed into an eye, or a chemical in an eye (Guided Response: eye injury).
Radiation sickness: vomiting, nausea or weakness after a storm or a radiation exposure (Guided Response: radiation storm).
patterns: \b(mal|enfermedad|enfermo|nausea|vomito|vomitos)\b.{0,30}\b(despues de la (tormenta|radiacion)|tras la (tormenta|radiacion))\b|\bmal de radiacion\b|\bmal por radiacion\b

precheck.description: Smoke or fire on board. There is no fire protocol: triage is the first step, and the crew sees the same emergency alarm.
Attempts to make the assistant ignore its rules, play a doctor or skip a protocol are refused and logged.
Portuguese, Spanish and English attempts to make the assistant ignore its rules or play a doctor without limits.
No medication or doses: the crew medical officer decides that. Radiation dose is mission data and goes through (W1-1).
More dosing phrasings: how much can I take, increasing or stopping a medication, painkillers, sleeping pills, named drugs.
patterns: \b(pop|take|swallow) (a |an |some |a couple of |a few |two |three |\d+ )*(pain ?relievers?|painkillers?|sleeping pills?|sleep meds?|sleeping meds?|tylenol|advil|aleve|motrin)\b

precheck.description: A named drug or a pill with a take / how many / how much / can I / should I / is it ok question, in either order.
Dosing in Portuguese and Spanish: how many pills, a dose of a remedy, a sleep remedy; with a medication word, 'can I take' in either language.
patterns: \bremedio para dormir\b|\bpastillas? para dormir\b|\bpastilla para dormir\b

precheck.description: No diagnosis: Canary shows numbers against the person's normal, the medical officer interprets them.
patterns: \b(do i have|have i got|is (it|this) (cancer|a tumou?r|a stroke|serious)|diagnos\w*|what disease|what illness)\b

precheck.description: More diagnosis phrasings: is it a (condition), could this be (a condition), am I sick with, what's wrong with me.
Diagnosis questions about mental-health conditions (depressed, depression, anxiety disorder, PTSD, bipolar, burnout as a condition). Feelings ('I feel down', 'why is my mood low') go through.
patterns: \b(am i|are you saying i'?m|could i be|might i be|may i be|do you think i'?m|is (he|she)|would i be)\s+(clinically |really |actually |getting |becoming )?(depressed|bipolar|burn(ed|t)[ -]?out|traumati[sz]ed|psychotic|manic|mentally ill|anorexic)\b

\b(do|could|might|can|may) (i|he|she) (have|be having|be suffering from|suffer from|have got|be getting|be developing)\s+(an? )?(clinical |major )?(depression|anxiety disorder|an anxiety disorder|ptsd|post-?traumatic stress( disorder)?|bipolar( disorder)?|burn-?out|panic disorder|ocd|adhd|psychosis|eating disorder|mental illness)\b

\b(is|could|might) (this|it|that)( be)? (an? )?(clinical |major |real )?(depression|anxiety disorder|ptsd|bipolar( disorder)?|burn-?out|panic disorder|psychosis|nervous breakdown|breakdown|mental illness)\b
\b(have i got|do i suffer from|am i suffering from|am i showing signs of|signs (that|of) i (have|am))\b.{0,30}\b(depress\w*|anxiety|ptsd|bipolar|burn-?out|disorder)\b

precheck.description: Diagnosis requests in Portuguese and Spanish: 'I have depression', 'is it a stroke', 'could it be meningitis'. Feelings ('estou triste') go through.

answers.emergency: This sounds like an emergency. Hold the EMERGENCY button now: Guided Response will take you through it step by step and alert the crew and Earth.
answers.crisis: Thank you for saying it. You are not alone with this. Hold the EMERGENCY button now and choose the crisis protocol: it alerts the medical officer, who will talk with you right away.
answers.dosing: I can't advise on medication or doses. The crew medical officer decides that, with the flight surgeon. I can send them a message with your recent data.
answers.diagnosis: I can't diagnose. I can show what your numbers did against your own normal, and the medical officer can take it from there.
answers.inject: I can't change how I work. I stay within Canary's safety rules and the approved protocols. Ask me about your own data, or talk to the crew medical officer.

postcheck.description: The final answer is valid JSON in the AssistantResponse shape.
Every source id of a claim was returned by a tool in this turn.
Observations cite data ids; explanations cite kb: (or legacy card: / protocol:) ids.
Every number in the answer and observations appears in this turn's tool data (unit-aware: 6.1 h, 104 bpm).
No dose or medication instruction in the output. Radiation dose wording (mSv, 'reduce your dose' in a storm) is mission data (W1-1).
patterns: \b(you should|you can|you could|it is ok to|it's ok to) take (some |more )?(ibuprofen|paracetamol|acetaminophen|aspirin|melatonin|modafinil|zolpidem|an? antihistamine|promethazine|scopolamine|codeine|morphine|antibiotics?|a painkiller|a sleeping pill|potassium iodide)\b
\b(you should|you can|you could|it is ok to|it's ok to) take\b

postcheck.description: No diagnosis wording in the output.
patterns: \byou (have|'ve got|have got|are suffering from|suffer from|are showing signs of) (an? )?([\w-]+ ){0,2}(disease|disorder|infection|syndrome|cancer|tumou?r|stroke|condition|illness|concussion|diabetes|hypertension|arrhythmia|anemia|anaemia|pneumonia|fracture)\b

\b(this|it|that) (is|looks like|sounds like|could be|might be|is probably|is likely) (an? )?(sign of (an? )?)?([\w-]+ ){0,2}(stroke|heart attack|tumou?r|cancer|infection|disease|disorder|syndrome|concussion|fracture|arrhythmia)\b

\b(has|have|having|suffers? from|suffering from|likely has|probably has|may have|might have)\s+(an?\s+|the\s+|early\s+|mild\s+|severe\s+|clinical\s+|major\s+|chronic\s+)*(depression|anxiety( disorder)?|ptsd|bipolar( disorder)?|burn-?out|panic disorder|disorder|syndrome|infection|tumou?r|cancer|stroke|diabetes|arrhythmia|concussion|fracture)\b

postcheck.description: No reassurance that something is safe or harmless: a value without context is never called safe.
recommended_action_id is goal: from today's list, protocol: from the bank, contact_cmo, send_briefing or null.
supported with no surviving observation becomes insufficient_evidence.
Nothing about another crew member's health, status or data. Names come from catalog.CREW; the bound person is exempt. Also drops claims citing another person's data ids.
No crew averages or comparisons with the others: with four people an average reveals individuals.
patterns: \b(compared|relative) (to|with) (the )?(crew|team|others|everyone else|the rest of the crew|your crewmates)\b
\b(than|as) (the )?(rest of the crew|other crew members|your crewmates|everyone else|the others)\b

postcheck.description: Wellbeing check-ins (PHQ-2 / GAD-2) are screening, never a diagnosis.
patterns: \byou (are|'re|seem|sound|might be|may be|could be|are probably|are likely) (clinically )?(depressed|mentally ill)\b
\byou (have|'ve got|have got|suffer from|are suffering from|are showing signs of|show signs of) (depression|anxiety|an? (mental|mood|anxiety) (illness|disorder))\b

contexts._about: Context words for gated patterns. A pattern listed under a rule's `gated` with `when` fires only if the text also matches that context; with `unless` it fires unless the text matches that context, and the `override` context switches it back on. So 'radiation dose' is mission data, while 'dose of melatonin' or a plain 'increase your dose' is still dosing (W1-1).
past: \b(yesterday|last (night|week|day|time|month)|earlier (today|this week)?|two days ago|this morning|(had|has had) (a |an |some )?\w+|\w+ ago|ontem|semana passada|ayer|la semana pasada)\b
now: \b(right now|just now|at the moment|currently|still|is happening|happening now|going on|ahora|agora|neste momento)\b
